findings.title: Lightning flash overlay stuck after storm→clear transition
findings.detail: renderWeather() returns early for clear weather (line 2100) before reaching the lightning overlay cleanup code (lines 2128-2134). When weather transitions from storm to clear, updateWeather() sets lightningFlash=0 but the #lightning-flash div opacity is never reset, leaving a permanent white overlay on screen.

findings.title: DOM lookup repeated every frame in render loop
findings.detail: document.getElementById('lightning-flash') is called up to twice per frame in renderWeather(), a hot render path. Should be cached at module scope to avoid repeated DOM queries.
